verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM for macOS and Windows. Admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture, enforce security settings, and apply a one-click secure baseline from the same compliance dashboard. However, the evidence never names the specific checks in the story or shows that posture is tracked per employee. missing for 10: explicit disk-encryption and screen-lock posture checks, password-manager detection, per-employee mapping of device compliance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
